scope: real execution snapshot producer and offline artifact chain
changes: A bounded snapshot producer hashes actual execution output and side-effect files into the strict exit_code/timed_out/outputs/side_effects schema.
Observed files are opened read-only with O_NOFOLLOW when available and checked with fstat before hashing.
Duplicate or invalid labels, symlinks, oversized/nonregular files, empty output sets and existing snapshot evidence fail closed.
An offline chain test binds real input bytes, real output bytes, snapshot JSON, v1 manifest and artifact ZIP digest without granting acceptance.
blocker: The five current workflows do not yet expose a common real behavior input and side-effect snapshot contract; fixture reports must not be relabeled as 92-workflow parity evidence.
